management_remarks: During Q3 FY25,festive season retail credit demand and strong SME ecosystem throughput propelled ICICI Bank's core operating profit to a record high. Our digital banking platforms processed record transaction volumes, driving fee income growth of 16.2% year-on-year across wealth management, cards, and transaction banking. Capital adequacy remains exceptionally strong with Tier-1 CAR above 16%, positioning the bank for sustained market share gains across high-ROE segments.
analyst_qa: Addressing questions on CASA ratio compression, retail savers shifting toward higher-yielding term deposits creates structural funding headwinds that are challenging to reverse overnight. We remain cautious on low-margin corporate refinancing deals and maintain a calibrated stance on unsecured retail disbursements. Future margin stability is subject to RBI monetary policy timing and moderating credit-to-deposit ratio pressures.
